summary.zh: 用读屏器验证网页的无障碍可用性
summary.en: Validate accessibility with VoiceOver, NVDA and JAWS

description.zh: 给出 VoiceOver、NVDA、JAWS 等读屏器的测试流程，覆盖 ARIA 实现、表单和动态内容播报的检查点。适合上线前验证无障碍支持或排查读屏异常。需要在对应系统上安装读屏器并人工操作。
description.en: Provides test flows for VoiceOver, NVDA and JAWS, covering ARIA, forms and dynamic content announcements. Suits pre-release accessibility checks or debugging assistive-tech issues. Requires the screen readers and manual testing.
